And the whole world falls asleep.

lines: Tum mujhse milne shama jala kar
couplets.en: Light a candle when you come to meet me.
Come to the Taj Mahal.

lines: Yeh Taj Mahal jo chahat ki
couplets.en: This Taj Mahal belongs to love.
It is the golden pearl in love's eyes.

lines: Har raat jahan do roohon ki
couplets.en: Here, two souls meet each night.
Their silence comes alive.

lines: Is Taj ke saaye mein aakar
couplets.en: Come into the shadow of the Taj.
Sing the song of devotion once more.

lines: Tum mujhse milne shama jala kar
couplets.en: Light a candle when you come to meet me.
Come to the Taj Mahal.
When the veil of night begins to stir.
Solitude seems wide awake.
Everything around it lies asleep.
As though within your dreams.

lines: Khud Taj Mahal ho khoya hua
couplets.en: The Taj Mahal itself were lost.
You are the dream of the Taj Mahal.
I never saw what lay hidden there.

lines: Tum mujhse milne shama jala kar
couplets.en: Light a candle when you come to meet me.
Come to the Taj Mahal.
When the veil of night begins to stir.
When death comes in the midst of love.

lines: Woh jaan se badh kar pyari hai
couplets.en: It is dearer than life itself.

lines: Do pyar bhare dil roshan hain
couplets.en: Two hearts in love are alight.
Though the night is dark.

lines: Tum raat ke is andhiyare mein
couplets.en: Here in the darkness of this night.
Let me catch just one glimpse of you.

Come to the Taj Mahal.
When the veil of night begins to stir.
And the whole world falls asleep.
